0.0: What I need is someone to help me straighten all of this out. If I don't start correcting these mistakes, their effects will only grow bigger.\r\n#L0##bWhy are you asking me to do this? Shouldn't you be fixing this yourself?#l\n#k
0.1: Do I look like some honorless bum to you? I'm asking you because I can't do it myself. My influence has already caused these problems...any more interference by me, and things may fall apart completely. But you can correct my mistakes, and balance things out. That may be the only way to avoid disaster...\r\n#L0##bDisaster? Is it really that bad?#l\n#k
0.2: Too much interference could cause the complete collapse of the timeline...destruction of an entire world. So yes, it really is that bad. Are you willing to help?

yes.0: I appreciate your eagerness. Take the watch you used before and go pick up my belongings in the #byear 2021#k. #rThe watch is an ordinary silver pocket watch with my name on it#k so it should be easy to find.

no.0: Maybe I didn't explain this clearly. You NEED to do something about this.

1.0: You found my watch?\r\n#L0##bHere it is. Slimes were all over the school when I got to 2021. I found the watch after taking care of them.#l\n#k
1.1: Slimes... That time period has already changed more than I expected. This is worse than I thought. If only I knew what caused the malfunction of my device...\r\n#L0##bIs this all there is to it?#l\n#k
1.2: Sorry, but this is only the beginning. The watch you just found is just an ordinary watch, but it still summoned slimes that didn't exist before. But the items I dropped in other time periods hold a lot of power...

yes.0: I'll hold onto the watch. The next time period is #r2099#k.
